crossRefs.note: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
“ ‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.
So Samuel called to Yahweh; and Yahweh sent thunder and rain that day. Then all the people greatly feared Yahweh and…
My son, fear Yahweh and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious;
Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her…
Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of…
Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect: not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
“Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
“ ‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.
“Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:
“that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”
Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies…
Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.
Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and…
Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman, as to the weaker…

translations.web: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.
translations.bsb: Pay everyone what you owe him: taxes to whom taxes are due, revenue to whom revenue is due, respect to whom respect is due, honor to whom honor is due.
translations.kjv: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
translations.asv: Render to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honor to whom honor.
